explication: Glamour is a Go library for stylesheet-driven Markdown rendering to ANSI-compatible terminal output. Its principal workflow accepts Markdown through the public renderer API, parses it with Goldmark, maps Markdown nodes to renderable ANSI elements, and produces styled text. Distinct capabilities include syntax-highlighted code, links and table link footers, emoji, and selectable built-in or file-based styles. The graph reflects the excerpts and README; unsampled renderer internals are represented only where documented, so uncertain implementation links are omitted.
